name: Panel Entitled "Femme à marguerite" (Woman with Daisy)
description: Palette extracted from the public-domain work “Panel Entitled "Femme à marguerite" (Woman with Daisy)” by Alphonse Marie Mucha (c. 1898/1900), Art Institute of Chicago artwork 182672. Adapted for high-contrast GameCore 5.1 UI.
changelog: 1.0.0 — source-backed palette; ≥7:1 body text and ≥4.5:1 controls.
